runtime.rule: Use each dependency's build for the actual game runtime. Enabled ESP markers alone do not prove compatible DLL versions or effective mesh winners.

installationPolicy: Every independent mod and every required dependency is installed as its own source-accounted mod under its real name. Inspect FOMOD alternatives, install selected files and verify the archive's Installed state. Generated BodySlide output is a separate generated mod.

projects: HIMBO Body - Vanilla High Poly Nevernude
photography.neutralAuthorDefaults: Use neutral visible shape while retaining the author's hidden seam/weight defaults; actor shapes come from OBody.
photography.overrides: Generated NeverNude human NIF/TRI output must win over nude generated bodies. Disable The New Gentleman and its plugin in this photography profile.
photography.redistribution: Human meshes, textures, skeletons and BodySlide dependencies are not bundled in this repository's test kit. Build or install them from their own authorized mods.
photography.lighting: Optional test_CLAWInspectionLighting.esp is built from lighting/ and enabled only in the CLAW inspection profile.
